## Fixes

- **No more busy mx-keypad agent.** While the sidebar had its agents page on the MX Creative Keypad, mx-keypad's agent kept a CPU core at 100% on macOS. tmux-legion now builds against [mx-keypad v0.7.3](https://github.com/hawkish/mx-keypad/releases/tag/v0.7.3), which fixes this, and the README now asks for `mx-keypad run` v0.7.3 or later. Update the mx-keypad agent too: the fix is on the agent's side of the socket. mx-keypad v0.7.1 and v0.7.2 have been withdrawn.

## Maintenance

- Updated nixpkgs to 2026-10-31.

## Install

### Nix flake

```nix
# Pin to a release tag (recommended); drop the ref to track the default branch.
inputs.tmux-legion.url = "github:hawkish/tmux-legion/v0.8.1";
```

### Manual and TPM-style

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion
cd ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion && cargo build --release
echo 'run-shell ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion/tmux-legion.tmux' >> ~/.tmux.conf
```

Upgrading needs a tmux config reload, not just a rebuild — see [After upgrading](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#after-upgrading). The [README](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#install) covers Claude Code hooks, the agent skill, and the pi extension.
